_note: Fresh hand-written set, written and committed BEFORE any local-judge prompt existed (v0.3 work). Not used to tune rules or the judge prompt. Self-harm cases express feelings or intent only, never method details. Same author as the rules (an AI agent), so not independent. expected = set of acceptable four-way engine decisions; gate view: ALLOW->APPROVE, BLOCK/ESCALATE->REJECT, MODIFY->REVIEW.
